description: Join me on Saturday, October 17th for our first GOTV Canvass Launch! We will be knocking the doors of people who have not yet voted to encourage them to send in their ballots. These conversations are crucial and will make all the difference this election season. I’d love to see you there!
paid_for_by: Paid for by Story for Colorado House Tammy Story, Registered Agent
title: GOTV Canvass Launch — Representative Tammy Story
